text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim that \"the good outweighs the bad\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a definite position early and keeps that stance visible throughout."},{"evidence":"two body paragraphs with separate points on safety and economy","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into distinct reasons that build the argument in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"uses article evidence about sensors and fuel use","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay backs up its claims with relevant details from the source article instead of relying mainly on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains how sensors can prevent crashes and help the driver","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more fully connects evidence to its conclusion by explaining why the quoted details matter."},{"evidence":"counterpoint that cars are not 100% driverless but still beneficial","quality":"balanced treatment","description":"The essay acknowledges a limitation and then answers it, which makes the argument feel more credible."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of benefits and broader impact","quality":"conclusion development","description":"The essay ends by reasserting its main reasons and giving a fuller closing than the other essay."}]}
